subject: Service continuity notice & CEO liaison — Acme Health
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Service continuity notice & CEO liaison — Acme Health

Team —

We began seeing elevated error rates on a subset of RPS for the text-generation path affecting a small number of accounts overnight. Acme Health is in the impacted cohort; their primary traffic is hitting the regional pool in us-west-2.

Initial facts:
- Incident detected: 2027-06-21 03:48 UTC (alerting threshold crossed on request 5xx)
- Scope: degraded 95th percentile latency, transient 5xxs for ~7% of tokens for Acme production keys
- Current mitigation: automated failover to warm replica pools started at 06:20 UTC; partial relief observed but some sessions are still seeing truncation/failures

Immediate asks:
1) Ben — can you confirm failover progress and expected full-restoral ETA?
2) Marissa — please pull a one-page SitRep (customer-facing) that summarizes the impact, actions, and timeline for exec outreach. Attach to this thread.
3) Vivek — I want a short note from the CEO office we can send to Acme leadership acknowledging impact and commitment to remediation. Keep it short and action-forward.

I'll take point on customer comms once I have the SitRep and the CEO blurb. We'll escalate if failover isn't fully stabilizing in the next 60 minutes.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.com]

[attachment: redwood_sitrep_2027-06-21.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service continuity notice & CEO liaison — Acme Health

Rachel —

Quick update from infra: failover to warm replicas completed for ~80% of impacted connections at 08:20 PDT (06:20 UTC). We're still seeing token-level truncations on long-stream sessions where the KV cache reseed timed out; working a focused patch to rehydrate KV state for those sessions.

ETA: aiming for full recovery in 45-60 minutes, contingent on KV reseed completing and a small kernel restart rolling out to the us-west-2 pool. I will update every 20 minutes.

I'll attach the failover timeline CSV once it's sanitized.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Infrastructure Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: failover-timeline.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Service continuity notice — Acme Health (CEO outreach included)

Dana —

I’m reaching out to let you know we detected a service degradation affecting a subset of requests in the US West region this morning. Our team moved to failover and applied a mitigation plan; most traffic restored to normal, but we recognize you likely saw intermittent failures and some truncated responses for sessions around 06:15–07:10 UTC.

What we did:
- Triggered automated failover to warm replicas (completed ~06:20 UTC)
- Applied targeted KV-cache rehydration work to repair long-session truncations
- Deployed a non-disruptive kernel patch to us-west-2 pool to stop repeated reseed timeouts

What you can expect:
- Immediate: most customer traffic is serving from replicas; fewer than 2% of requests are still affected
- Short term (under 1 hour): our ops team anticipates full recovery for all sessions
- Next steps: a follow-up postmortem with timeline, root cause analysis, and corrective actions will be shared within 48 hours

We take availability seriously and I want to make sure you have a direct line to senior execs. Vivek Kulkarni (cc’d) will send a brief note from our CEO offering a direct commitment and next steps.

Please let me know if you have immediate customer impacts we should prioritize or if you prefer a quick call. We can set up a 15‑minute bridge if helpful.

Sincerely,
Rachel Kim | Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.com]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Short note from the CEO — Acme Health incident

Dana —

On behalf of Redwood’s leadership I want to extend my apologies for the interruption you experienced this morning. We know Acme Health relies on predictable inference for critical workflows and any degradation is unacceptable.

Immediate commitments from the CEO office:
- A full postmortem within 48 hours with clear remediation actions and owner assignments
- Prioritized testing and hardening of our KV reseed path for customers in regulated healthcare workloads
- A customer-impact review with your engineering leadership to ensure our fixes address any edge cases in your integration

Rachel and the ops team will follow up with the detailed SitRep and timeline. If you are available today, I can join a 15‑minute call to personally acknowledge this and answer any questions.

—Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer & Partner Success (on behalf of CEO)
Redwood Inference
[vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com]

From: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service continuity notice — Acme Health (CEO outreach included)

Rachel / Vivek —

Thanks for the transparency and quick action. We did see truncated transcripts for a small percentage of inference calls during the window you noted; luckily our retry logic prevented material downstream failures, but this did cause follow-on alerts on our side.

We appreciate the offer to join a quick call — Dana and I can do 17:15 PDT today for 15 minutes. Please send a calendar invite and brief agenda. We look forward to the postmortem.

Best,
Dana Lewis
Head of AI Integrations, Acme Health
